description: nhflow_3d_curv_dambreak_rot90 hydrostatic with the semi-implicit one-step predictor (A 510 11, theta 0.5): the BCG advection on a curvilinear grid (slopes per index, the normal velocity of the face, the transverse term over the centre distance along the face) and the face depths and omega at t^{n+1/2}. Checked by hand: the same basin on its grid turned by a further 90 deg gives eta and WL per cell index equal to 3.3e-16 m and the turned velocities to 8e-16 m/s after 30 steps.
covers: nh_begin: the BCG face depth along the face normal
